title: Critique: the theory is a kind of behaviorism

statements.text: Ned Block argues that a major strand of the view is a nonstandard behaviorism, since sensorimotor contingencies are input-output relations, while experience is a matter of what mediates between input and output.

sources.quote: A major strand of O’Regan & Noë’s view turns out to be a type of behaviorism
experience is a matter of what mediates between input and output, not input-output relations all by themselves
